title: OCTR2A: Real-Time RGB-to-BEV Trajectory Projection and Forecasting at Urban Intersections
abstract: arXiv:2611.24352v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Trajectory forecasting at urban intersections is often studied assuming that reliable bird's-eye-view (BEV) motion histories are available, which in practice requires costly resources such as LiDAR, aerial views, HD maps, or calibrated infrastructure. We address this upstream perception-to-forecasting problem by reconstructing and predicting agents' BEV trajectories only from paired opposite-corner RGB cameras mounted on existing urban infrastructure at variable heights at inference time. We introduce the Opposite-Corner Trajectory Reconstruction and Anticipation Architecture (OCTR2A), a modular pipeline integrating per-view detection with class refinement, geometric cross-camera matching, transformer-based BEV projection, and egocentric GRU forecasting, trained in cascade and mainly supervised with a soft multi-scale spatial-overlap loss. translated_title: OCTR2A：城市交叉口实时RGB到鸟瞰图（BEV）轨迹投影与预测
translated_abstract: 城市交叉口的轨迹预测研究通常假设可靠的鸟瞰图（BEV）运动历史是可获得的，而这在实践中需要昂贵资源，如激光雷达、航拍视角、高精地图或经过标定的基础设施。我们通过仅使用安装在现有城市基础设施上、高度可变的对角成对RGB相机，在推理时重建并预测交通参与者的BEV轨迹，从而解决这一从感知到预测的上游问题。我们提出了对角轨迹重建与预测架构（OCTR2A），这是一个模块化流水线，集成了带类别细化的单视角检测、几何跨相机匹配、基于Transformer的BEV投影以及以自身为中心的GRU轨迹预测，采用级联方式训练，并主要以软多尺度空间重叠损失进行监督。由于目前没有公开基准提供这种传感配置，我们引入了基于Blender构建的R3ST++……（摘要未完整提供）
tldr: 本文提出OCTR2A架构，仅利用现有城市基础设施上的对角成对RGB相机即可实时重建并预测交叉口交通参与者的鸟瞰图轨迹，无需激光雷达、航拍或高精地图等昂贵资源。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes OCTR2A, which reconstructs and forecasts agents' bird's-eye-view trajectories at urban intersections in real time using only paired opposite-corner RGB cameras mounted on existing infrastructure, eliminating the need for costly resources such as LiDAR, aerial views, or HD maps.
